title: Old Friends
setting: a park with a tree in the middle and a bench on the right, both in the back layer.
shots: A green stick figure walks in from the left and a purple stick figure walks in from the right; they stop face to face near the tree.
The purple figure walks to the bench, the green figure follows a little behind and waves goodbye.
The purple figure turns to face the camera and waves too.
camera: show both figures the whole time, then zoom in a little at the end.
